h:
Z-Image Turbo 一体化 ComfyUI 工作流程

生成、细节设计、放大、精加工、ControlNet、修复和 Flux Edit 在一个模块化工作流程中。

该工作流程构建为ComfyUI 内 Z-Image Turbo 的一体化生产流程.
目标很简单：生成强大的基础图像，细化重要细节，升级它，完善最终外观，并为姿势控制、图像提示、修复和透视变化保持足够的灵活性。

它专为那些想要的不仅仅是简单的文本到图像工作流程的人而设计。这是一个用于电影、逼真和风格化图像创作的完整创意工作空间。

此工作流程包括哪些内容

核心一代基于Z 图像涡轮增压，然后是几个可选的细化阶段：

  • 眼部细节师让眼睛更锐利、更干净

  • 脸部细节师提高面部一致性和质量

  • SeedVR 升级用于高分辨率输出

  • 色彩校正最终图像平衡

  • HDR/对比度增强以获得更强烈的电影效果

  • 胶片颗粒以获得更有机的最终效果

  • 洛拉装载机

它还包括多个控制和实用程序部分：

  • ControlNet 预处理器

    • 动态姿态

    • 精明的

    • 深度

    • 等等...

  • 图像到提示

    • 对于分析参考图像和构建更好的提示很有用

  • 修复

    • 用于本地修复、更正和创意编辑

  • Flux编辑集成

    • 由于 Z-Image Turbo 目前没有成熟的 PuLID / IP-Adapter 风格的身份工作流程，因此 Flux Edit 作为附加编辑选项包含在内。

    • 这对于透视变化、更强的图像编辑、姿势调整或在保持整体视觉方向的同时重新处理现有图像非常有用。

为什么我做了这个

我想要一个感觉更接近完整图像生产管道而不是单生成图的工作流程。
Z-Image Turbo 速度快且功能强大，但对于精美的最终图像，我经常需要额外的步骤：更好的眼睛、更好的面孔、更干净的高档、更强的色彩分级以及用于控制构图的工具。

此工作流程将这些步骤合并到一个模块化设置中，因此您可以仅启用所需的部分。

推荐使用案例

该工作流程可用于：

  • 电影肖像

  • 人物图像

  • 时尚/生活方式拍摄

  • 逼真的AI摄影

  • 社交媒体视觉效果

  • 控制姿势世代

  • 图像编辑和变化

  • 放大的最终渲染

  • 从参考图像中快速提取

  • 修复和修正通道

注释


您可能需要安装所需的自定义节点并手动下载必要的模型。

不包括模型文件。请检查您是否在正确的 ComfyUI 文件夹中安装了所需的 Z-Image、SeedVR、ControlNet、detailer、inpainting 和 Flux Edit 模型。

工作流程有意模块化。如果特定图像不需要它们，您可以绕过升级、细节器、ControlNet 或 Flux Edit 等部分。

在 RTX 4070 10GB 和 5080 16GB 上测试

主要使用型号：

z_图片_Turbo_bf16.safetensors

Flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors

Qwen3-VL-2B-指令

sam3.safetensors

Seedvr2_ema_3b_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors

安全张量

full_encoder_small_decoder.safetensors

qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors

我的目标

此工作流程的目标是为创作者提供一个灵活的起点，以实现更完整的 Z-Image Turbo 管道：
在一个干净的 ComfyUI 工作流程中生成、控制、修复、升级和完成图像。

请随意修改、改进并使其适应您自己的风格。
如果你用它创造了一些很酷的东西，我很乐意看到你的结果！

Z-Image Turbo All-in-One ComfyUI Workflow

Generation, detailing, upscaling, finishing, ControlNet, inpainting and Flux Edit in one modular workflow.

This workflow is built as anall-in-one production pipeline for Z-Image Turbo inside ComfyUI.
The goal is simple: generate a strong base image, refine the important details, upscale it, polish the final look, and keep enough flexibility for pose control, image prompting, inpainting and perspective changes.

It is designed for people who want more than a simple text-to-image workflow. This is meant as a complete creative workspace for cinematic, photorealistic and stylized image creation.

What this workflow includes

The core generation is based onZ-Image Turbo, followed by several optional refinement stages:

  • Eye Detailerfor sharper and cleaner eyes

  • Face Detailerfor improved facial consistency and quality

  • SeedVR Upscalingfor high-resolution output

  • Color Correctionfor final image balancing

  • HDR / contrast enhancementfor a stronger cinematic look

  • Film Grainfor a more organic final finish

  • LORA Loader

It also includes multiple control and utility sections:

  • ControlNet preprocessors

    • DWPose

    • Canny

    • Depth

    • etc...

  • Image-to-Prompt

    • Useful for analyzing reference images and building better prompts

  • Inpainting

    • For local fixes, corrections and creative edits

  • Flux Edit integration

    • Since Z-Image Turbo currently does not have a mature PuLID / IP-Adapter style identity workflow, Flux Edit is included as an additional editing option.

    • This can be useful for perspective changes, stronger image edits, pose adjustments or reworking an existing image while keeping the overall visual direction.

Why I made this

I wanted a workflow that feels closer to a full image production pipeline instead of a single generation graph.
Z-Image Turbo is fast and powerful, but for polished final images I often want additional steps: better eyes, better faces, cleaner upscale, stronger color grading, and tools for controlled composition.

This workflow combines those steps into one modular setup, so you can enable only the parts you need.

Recommended use cases

This workflow can be used for:

  • cinematic portraits

  • character images

  • fashion / lifestyle shots

  • realistic AI photography

  • social media visuals

  • controlled pose generations

  • image edits and variations

  • upscaled final renders

  • prompt extraction from reference images

  • inpainting and correction passes

Notes


You may need to install the required custom nodes and download the necessary models manually.

Model files are not included. Please check that you have the required Z-Image, SeedVR, ControlNet, detailer, inpainting and Flux Edit models installed in the correct ComfyUI folders.

The workflow is intentionally modular. You can bypass sections like upscaling, detailers, ControlNet or Flux Edit if you do not need them for a specific image.

Tested on RTX 4070 10GB and 5080 16GB

Main Models used:

z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors

flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors

Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct

sam3.safetensors

seedvr2_ema_3b_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors

ae.safetensors

full_encoder_small_decoder.safetensors

qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors

My goal

The goal of this workflow is to give creators a flexible starting point for a more complete Z-Image Turbo pipeline:
generate, control, repair, upscale and finish your image inside one clean ComfyUI workflow.

Feel free to modify it, improve it and adapt it to your own style.
If you create something cool with it, I would love to see your results!
